asked.item: Why Stripe says the invoice can no longer be paid
Must the old invoice be paid before using Blotato again
What to do after the card was declined

verdict.reason: The help page covers this exact Stripe message and says the old expired invoice does not need to be paid.

steps.text: That message means the invoice expired and Stripe closed it, so you cannot pay that specific invoice anymore.
You do not need to pay the old expired invoice.
Instead, start a fresh subscription with a working card: go to Settings > Billing and click View Billing Portal.
Update your payment method, and add a different card if your current card was declined.
Select the plan you want, then confirm checkout. Subscribing again generates a new invoice and reactivates your account.
